text: Felix Barros of Kingsmoor FC commits a foul on the left flank near the halfway line at the 81st minute. The referee shows him a second yellow card, followed immediately by a red card, sending him off and leaving Kingsmoor FC with ten players. At this moment, Kingsmoor trail Westport Albion 2 to 3. This dismissal intensifies the challenge for Kingsmoor, who have been struggling to break down Westport's defensive and pressing tactics in these final stages of the match [#1494] [#1495].
